_comment: The Personal Assistant, as content. Deliberately NOT a special case beside the manifest system — it is the same code path, which is the only honest test of whether the manifest can describe a real assistant. If the one we already have cannot be expressed here, neither can anyone else's.
blurb: Your day, your priorities, and whatever you have asked it to keep track of.
_whyRelayTimeout: 2026-10-04. Only matters when another assistant asks this one; the owner's own messages are not timed. The Daily Coordinator asks a Personal Assistant thread (LinkedIn Job Searcher) every morning, and the assistants it asks answered in 92-265 s (Oct 1-4) while the default 120 s relay timeout dropped those answers after they were paid for. 420 s covers that with room for the slot wait, which may take up to half the timeout (assistants/session-policy.json). Capped at 600 s by AssistantRelay.maxTurnTimeout.
